answer: Each epoch opens S identity slots, capped at 5% of actives. Aspirants file sealed burn-bids; the S-th highest sets one uniform clearing price, and winners burn it, no refund. Validators verify the burn proof inside each registration before the identity may vote, or the slot voids. A 50-token floor keeps cost linear: n slots cost at least 50n, burned forever, so capital cannot be reset, split, or prefarmed. Bids pass a prism, splitting honest demand from sybils; a grove of validators audits the log, pricing each fair admission as a pearl; unsold slots raise the floor 20%.
